title: Corey L NDE 6639
content: I do not remember what led up to my drowning, but I saw my life flash before my eyes. It included the events of my life with friends and family. I suddenly ‘woke up’ and felt like I was lying on a very soft and comfortable bed. The room was very bright, although the light didn't hurt my eyes. The room was very pleasant and it was full of my favorite toys! I saw my grandma and grandpa, who had recently died (Grandma had died three and a half months before my accident, and Grandpa, nine months before.) They both spoke to me, and my grandpa said, ‘What are you doing here? You shouldn't be here!’ I walked down a long hallway. I was in this giant mansion that was very bright and full of white light. My grandparents took me to my Uncle James who had died three years before, and he took me to my great-grandfather, who was also dead. I knew him well. Some other people were there, and, although I had never met them before, somehow I knew who they were. I saw my great-grandparents, who were deceased, and Great Aunt Helen, who got up from her wheelchair and walked over to me to hug me. They all told me I had to go back and live my life, but I had to live it differently. They said that I should start to care more about schoolwork and not fool around with my friends so much when I was at school. They all told me that they loved me and they wished me the best of luck in my future. My Uncle James told me to tell everyone that he was fine and that he loved everybody. The entire time I was with my family, I could feel their love. It was like a warm feeling all over me. I suddenly felt like I was on a moving platform and I saw Jesus! I knew instantly who he was, although he didn't tell me. He was dressed in a white robe. His presence felt warm and I could feel love coming off him. Jesus said I should go back to the living and live my life. Jesus vanished and God appeared to me. She was bright and I felt her love immediately (and, yes, God is a female.) She looked like the sun, with love coming off her in rays. (It's hard to explain, but she reminded me of a painting of the sun I had seen when I was very young, with light shining from the center of her body.) She hugged me and then suddenly she was gone. I saw images of my father flying in a plane. I then saw gates, and as I walked toward them, they opened and I walked through them. I remember seeing an ‘M’ on a window and then I found out I was in the hospital.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus appeared dressed in a white robe; then Jesus vanished and God appeared, described as female, bright like the sun with rays of love; God hugged the experiencer.
arrival.other_being_detail: Grandparents, uncle, great-grandfather, great-grandparents, and Great Aunt Helen (who rose from a wheelchair and hugged the experiencer); also 'some other people' the experiencer had not met but somehow knew.

environment.environment_other_detail: A very bright room with a soft comfortable bed; full of favorite toys; a long hallway; a giant mansion very bright and full of white light; later gates and a window with an 'M'.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told to go back and live life, but to live it differently (care more about schoolwork; not fool around with friends at school).
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt on a moving platform; later walked toward gates that opened; then found out they were in the hospital.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Live life differently: care more about schoolwork and not fool around with friends at school; also relay message that Uncle James was fine and loved everybody.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included a bright room with toys; long hallway and bright mansion; moving platform; appearance of Jesus then God; images of father flying in a plane; gates opened and walked through; saw an 'M' on a window; then hospital.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review occurred first; then waking in a bright room/bed with toys and deceased relatives; later hallway/mansion encounters; then moving platform with Jesus and God; then images of father; then gates and return to hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Environment included favorite toys; God described as female and like the sun with rays of love; saw images of father flying in a plane; saw an 'M' on a window before realizing they were in the hospital.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Grandpa said, ‘What are you doing here? You shouldn't be here!’; Uncle James told me to tell everyone that he was fine and that he loved everybody.
